measurements.portico_steps_projection_note: Portico and entry steps project about 3.34 m west of the structural GIS wall envelope; roof eaves extend about 0.22 m.

geometry_edits: Rebuilt wall base from the exact 21-vertex official FID 780 footprint in campus coordinates.
Replaced the generic massing block with two estimated brick stories and twin front-facing gables joined by a central dormered roof.
Added a columned central portico with pediment, entry door, repeated trimmed windows, dormers, chimney, and steps based on the non-scaled artist illustration.
Retained the expected campus-coordinate object identity transform and manifest collection name.
uncertainties: GIS NUM_LEVELS=1 conflicts with the two visible stories in the unscaled illustration; the GIS field meaning is unknown.
GIS Extrution=12 has no documented unit or meaning and was not treated as measured height.
The artist illustration is not georeferenced; west-facing frontage toward Russell Street is illustrative.
Exact floor heights, full roof plan, chimney dimensions, window rhythm, and all hidden elevations remain unverified.
